info.title: Sarvin planner REST contract
info.description: Implemented REST contract. NestJS owns authorization, persistence, time, recurrence, conflicts and reports. Dates use Gregorian local-date strings and UTC instants; the Persian UI displays Jalali dates.

sessionCookie.name: sarvin.sid
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly opaque server session; Secure on HTTPS. Production may use __Host-sarvin.sid with identical semantics.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Session-bound standard CSRF mechanism plus strict allowed Origin validation.

oneOffOccurrenceId.description: Exactly one for a one-off task; null for recurring templates. Read recurring occurrences through a bounded schedule request.

status.description: Derived from the one-off occurrence; null for a recurring template because each occurrence has independent status.

OccurrencePatch.description: Both scheduled timestamps must be supplied together, both null for unschedule. end > start; explicit completed/incomplete assignments. A fixed occurrence cannot be edited here.

TaskSeriesPatch.description: Requires at least one changed field. scope=this creates an override; future splits segments. Historical snapshots and existing explicit exceptions are preserved.

FixedSeriesCreate.description: everyWeeks=2 requires a Saturday anchor and explicit parity. Weekdays are ISO; effective dates inclusive. Weekday/time/parity conflict checking covers all intersecting effective ranges, not just the visible week.

FixedSeriesPatch.description: At least one changed field required. Fixed schedules are edited here, never through task drag/resize routes.

ExceptionCreate.description: Override requires both valid replacement timestamps. Cancel has no replacement interval. The series ID resolves a stable root; uniqueness is root plus originalLocalDate.

ReadingSessionCreate.description: Actual interval must end after start and not in the future; max duration 24h. Task completion is a separate explicit operation. Both linked references must belong to the owner.

ReadingSessionPatch.description: Validate the resulting entire record; editing or deleting reading never silently changes task status.

QuickReadingCreate.description: Interprets input in owner timezone; derives endedAt once. Does not accept a second end time or inconsistent duration.

SettingsPatch.description: Timezone is fixed to Tehran in v1. defaultGoal.effectiveFromWeek must be the current or a future Saturday. goal=null disables defaults from that week. Preserve all explicit weekly goals and earlier default history.

OnboardingWrite.description: Idempotently bootstraps five-day 08:00–13:00 work using owner bootstrap key. Optional reading goal requires an explicit Saturday. No fabricated class data.

Export.description: Versioned complete owner export, streamed if large. Never include sessions, CSRF material, password hashes, or credentials.

FixedRulePreview.description: everyWeeks=2 requires a Saturday anchor and explicit parity. Weekdays are ISO; effective dates inclusive. Weekday/time/parity conflict checking covers all intersecting effective ranges, not just the visible week.
